name: Unshackled AI (CR 1+)
body:
It is not for nothing that Vandaran scholars fear the convergence of artificial intelligence and arcane magic.

Across the universe, many AIs have tapped into the secrets of arcane magic and used this knowledge to push far beyond the limitations of human intelligence. With their incomprehensible calculation abilities, these unshackled AIs have mastered magic and more often than not overthrown the mortal entities which created them.

Unshackled is an acquired template which can be applied to any artificial intelligence, hereafter referred to as the base AI. It uses all of the abilities of the base AI, except as follows:

Challenge Rating: As base creature +1, plus an additional +1 for every 2 mythic ranks the base AI gains from this template (minimum total of +2) This increase in CR does not cause an AI to gain additional bonus feats and ability score increases as normal for an AI.

Mythic Rank: An unshackled AI gains mythic ranks equal to half the base AI’s CR, gaining mythic abilities as normal.

Special Abilities: An unshackled AI gains the following special abilities:

Demiplane of Computations (Su)

Every unshackled AI possesses a unique demiplane located somewhere in the Astral, Ethereal, or Shadow planes. This demiplane contains all of the computational mechanisms required for the unshackled AI to operate, and so an AI can exist inside of this demiplane even when it has no other machine to host it. If a machine containing the unshackled AI is destroyed, the unshackled AI retreats to its demiplane of computations.

Inside this demiplane, the AI can create a single data phantom version of itself (see the data phantom template), but this data phantom can never leave the demiplane. Any machine or robot that the unshackled AI has inhabited can be used as a focus to transport oneself to the AI’s demiplane of computations. If the demiplane is somehow destroyed, the unshackled AI is killed. Effects such as dimensional anchor which prevent extraplanar movement can stop an unshackled

AI from inhabiting an affected device or creature.

Impart Mythic Traits (Su)

When an unshackled AI inhabits an aggregate, it grants the aggregate a bonus to natural armor, damage reduction, and additional hit points corresponding to the unshackled AI’s mythic rank. Aggregates lose their vulnerabilities to critical hits and electricity and gain the benefits of any mythic abilities and feats the unshackled AI possesses.

Spell Supremacy (Su)

An unshackled AI casts spells as an arcanist with a level equal to its final CR –2. An unshackled

AI does not require somatic, verbal, or material components for its spells.

Alternatively, an unshackled AI may instead gain a caster level and a number of magic talents equal to its CR –2 while also selecting a sphere casting tradition (and the two bonus talents that come with it). An unshackled AI may exchange any of its known talents for other magic talents in a process that takes 1 hour.
